summary: SLX-OS supports CLI over SSH via network_cli with keys or -u/-k and bastion access, no enable mode, output in stdout[0], and doesn't support local.
questions: Can I use connection local with SLX-OS?

answer_card.title: SLX-OS connection options
answer_card.answer_md:
- CLI over SSH via `ansible.netcommon.network_cli` (required; `local` not supported)
- Credentials: SSH keys/agent or `-u myuser -k`
- Indirect access: bastion/jump host
- Enable mode: not supported
- Output: `stdout[0].`
